chinese: 把 A 应用于 B；把 A 涂、敷在 B 上
note: A 是方法、知识或物质等；B 是应用对象或表面。

example.english: Try to apply this rule to your own writing.
example.chinese: 试着把这条规则应用到你自己的写作中。

chinese: 到那时为止
note: by 强调不晚于那个时间。

example.english: The train leaves at six, so we must be ready by then.
example.chinese: 火车六点出发，所以我们到那时必须准备好。

chinese: 阻止某人做某事
note: 补全结构；from 后用动词 -ing。

example.english: The heavy snow prevented us from leaving the village.
example.chinese: 大雪使我们无法离开村庄。

note: 具体数字后不加 s，如 two hundred。

example.english: There are one hundred seats in this small theatre.
example.chinese: 这座小剧院有一百个座位。

example.english: More than a thousand people visited the exhibition.
example.chinese: 一千多人参观了这场展览。

note: 原笔记的数量级需要修正。

example.english: The game reached a million downloads in one month.
example.chinese: 这款游戏一个月内的下载量达到了一百万次。

note: 原笔记的“亿”不准确。

example.english: The proposed railway could cost two billion dollars.
example.chinese: 这条拟建铁路可能耗资二十亿美元。

chinese: 虽然；尽管；不过（作副词时）
note: 与 thought、through、thorough、tough 区分。

example.english: Though the room was small, it felt warm and welcoming.
example.chinese: 虽然房间很小，却让人觉得温暖而舒适。

chinese: 想法；思考；think 的过去式和过去分词
note: 不是一概等于“想起”。

example.english: A strange thought came to me on the bus.
example.chinese: 我在公交车上突然冒出了一个奇怪的想法。

chinese: 穿过；通过；自始至终

example.english: We walked through the tunnel and came out beside a river.
example.chinese: 我们穿过隧道，来到一条河边。

chinese: 彻底的；全面的；细致的

example.english: The mechanic gave the old car a thorough check.
example.chinese: 修理工对这辆旧车做了一次全面检查。

chinese: 艰难的；坚韧的；强硬的

example.english: Moving to a new city was tough at first.
example.chinese: 刚搬到一个新城市时，日子很不容易。

chinese: 目前；现在

example.english: The library is closed for repairs at present.
example.chinese: 图书馆目前因维修而关闭。

chinese: 遍及；贯穿整个时期；自始至终
note: 兼有空间和时间含义。

example.english: She stayed calm throughout the interview.
example.chinese: 她在整个面试过程中都保持冷静。

chinese: 彻底摧毁某物；使某地荒废
note: 比一般“毁坏”程度更强。

example.english: The wildfire laid waste to a large area of forest.
example.chinese: 这场野火彻底毁坏了一大片森林。

chinese: 确保某人得到某物
note: 保留原 ensure A for B，明确 A 是事物、B 是人。

example.english: The scholarship will ensure a place at the school for her.
example.chinese: 这份奖学金将确保她获得该校的入学名额。

chinese: 如今是……的事物或地方
note: 原图有“新的东西／情况”痕迹，按英文 now（现在）保留为从句结构；不是 What's new?。

example.english: The family once lived in what is now a museum.
example.chinese: 这家人曾住在一栋如今已成为博物馆的建筑里。

chinese: 根据；按照；据……所说

example.english: According to the timetable, the last bus leaves at ten.
example.chinese: 根据时刻表，末班车十点发车。

chinese: 以……为依据；基于……

example.english: The film is based on a novel I read at school.
example.chinese: 这部电影改编自我上学时读过的一部小说。

chinese: 做某事之后
note: 修正 after 的拼写；省略主语时通常与主句主语一致。

example.english: After finishing her homework, she went for a walk.
example.chinese: 做完作业后，她出去散了散步。

chinese: 被提议的；拟议的；propose 的过去式和过去分词
note: 原图是 proposed，不把词形静默改成 propose。

example.english: Residents are discussing the proposed new bridge.
example.chinese: 居民们正在讨论拟建的新桥。

chinese: 不过是……；比……多不了多少
note: 不同于 a little more than（比……多一点）。

example.english: The old shed was little more than a roof on four posts.
example.chinese: 那座旧棚子不过是四根柱子撑着一个屋顶。

chinese: 因……而出名
note: 修正 be know for。

example.english: This village is known for its colourful pottery.
example.chinese: 这个村庄因色彩鲜艳的陶器而出名。

chinese: 从 A 到 B 的各种可能事物；范围可以从 A 到 B
note: 不是指每一次必定包含区间里的所有事物。

example.english: The repair could take anything from an hour to a whole day.
example.chinese: 维修所需的时间可能是一小时，也可能长达一整天。

chinese: 不超过；至多

example.english: Please bring not more than two bags onto the bus.
example.chinese: 上车时请携带不超过两个包。

chinese: 满足需求／要求
note: 将原 meets“满足”补成可独立学习的搭配。

example.english: The new evening classes meet a need for flexible study.
example.chinese: 新开设的夜间课程满足了灵活学习的需求。

chinese: 占（某比例）；解释……的原因
note: 保留原比例义，同时补充常见解释义；还原动词原形。

example.english: Online orders account for half of the shop's sales.
example.chinese: 线上订单占这家店销售额的一半。

chinese: 最重要的是；尤其是
note: 不能简单等同于时间顺序上的“首先”。

example.english: Choose shoes that fit well and, above all, feel comfortable.
example.chinese: 要选合脚的鞋，最重要的是穿着舒服。

chinese: 延伸贯穿某物的全长
note: 按 runs the length of 还原；原“长度为”不够准确。

example.english: A narrow balcony runs the length of the apartment.
example.chinese: 一条狭窄的阳台沿着公寓延伸，贯穿其全长。

chinese: 接着做另一件事；随后进一步做某事
note: 对比 go on doing sth.：继续做同一件事。

example.english: She studied biology and then went on to become a teacher.
example.chinese: 她学习了生物学，后来成为了一名教师。

chinese: 隔热与隔音
note: thermal 修饰热；acoustic 修饰声音。

example.english: The new wall panels provide thermal and acoustic insulation.
example.chinese: 新的墙板能够隔热和隔音。

chinese: 成碎片；散成零块
note: 也可形容人精神崩溃；本卡优先保留原物理义。

example.english: I dropped the cup, and it landed in pieces on the floor.
example.chinese: 我把杯子摔了，它落在地上碎成了几块。

chinese: 非常适合……；是……的理想选择

example.english: This quiet room is ideal for reading.
example.chinese: 这个安静的房间非常适合阅读。

chinese: 由于；因为
note: 原笔记因果义；不与 be due to do（预计／预定做）混淆。

example.english: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
example.chinese: 比赛因大雨而取消了。

chinese: 由……引起；由……造成

example.english: The delay was caused by a broken signal.
example.chinese: 这次延误是由信号设备故障造成的。

chinese: 少至……；仅仅……（强调数量少）

example.english: You can practise for as little as five minutes a day.
example.chinese: 你每天只练习五分钟也可以。

chinese: 最初……，而在较近时期……
note: 时间顺序组合表达，不是独立习语。

example.english: She worked first in a café and more recently in a bookshop.
example.chinese: 她最初在咖啡馆工作，最近则在一家书店工作。

chinese: 就……的情况而言；在……这个例子中
note: 区别 in case of：万一发生……。

example.english: In the case of this old house, repairs may cost more than rebuilding.
example.chinese: 就这栋老房子的情况而言，修缮可能比重建更贵。

chinese: 与……一致；符合……

example.english: The wooden sign is in keeping with the style of the café.
example.chinese: 这块木制招牌与咖啡馆的风格一致。

chinese: 考虑到……；鉴于……
note: 此处是介词用法。

example.english: Given the short deadline, we should keep the plan simple.
example.chinese: 考虑到时间紧迫，我们应该让计划保持简单。

chinese: 与……有关；与……联系在一起

example.english: The smell of bread is associated with happy memories of home.
example.chinese: 面包的香味与家中美好的回忆联系在一起。

chinese: 只有在……之后才……
note: 句首 only after + 状语常使主句部分倒装。

example.english: Only after reading the instructions did I understand the game.
example.chinese: 我只有在读完说明之后，才明白这个游戏怎么玩。

chinese: 而不是；而非

example.english: We took the stairs rather than waiting for the lift.
example.chinese: 我们走了楼梯，而没有等电梯。

chinese: 某事物的变体；略有不同的形式
note: 原 variant on 可成立，补上不定冠词。

example.english: Her recipe is a variant on a traditional soup.
example.chinese: 她的食谱是一种传统汤品的改良版本。

english: bring A into contact with B
chinese: 使 A 与 B 接触

example.english: The workshop brings young designers into contact with local craftspeople.
example.chinese: 这场工作坊让年轻设计师有机会接触当地手艺人。

chinese: 比……差；不如……
note: 用 to，不用 than。

example.english: The cheaper camera is inferior to the other one in low light.
example.chinese: 在弱光条件下，这台便宜的相机不如另一台。

chinese: 它是什么；它现在的样子或状况
note: 这是名词性从句片段，不是独立固定词组。

example.english: The café is not perfect, but I like it for what it is.
example.chinese: 这家咖啡馆并不完美，但我喜欢它本来的样子。

chinese: 它过去是什么；它过去的样子或状况
note: 保留与 what it is 的时态对照。

example.english: The quiet village is very different from what it was ten years ago.
example.chinese: 这个安静的村庄与十年前的样子大不相同。

chinese: 弄懂；算出；解决
note: 按原“弄清楚”保留相关义；另有锻炼、进展等义。

example.english: We finally worked out why the printer kept stopping.
example.chinese: 我们终于弄清了打印机为何总是停止工作。

chinese: 超出……；超过……的范围或限度
note: 原“不局限于”可作为语境译法。

example.english: Her answer went beyond the question and raised a new issue.
example.chinese: 她的回答超出了原问题的范围，又提出了一个新问题。

english: from A, through B, to C
chinese: 从 A 经由 B 到 C
note: 普通介词组合，A/B/C 可为地点、阶段或类别。

example.english: The path leads from the gate, through the garden, to the lake.
example.chinese: 这条小路从大门出发，穿过花园，通向湖边。

chinese: ……的事物；所……的东西（引导名词性从句时）
note: 限定名词性关系从句用法，疑问词 what 不一概如此。

example.english: I wrote down what she said so I would not forget it.
example.chinese: 我把她说的话记了下来，以免忘记。

chinese: 由……逐渐发展而来；因长大而不再适合或不再有
note: 原图只记发展义，补充常见成长义。

example.english: The reading club grew out of a weekly chat between friends.
example.chinese: 这个读书会由朋友们每周的一次聊天逐渐发展而来。

english: have a lot going for it
chinese: 有很多优点；具备许多有利条件
note: 从“有很多好处”规范为事物本身具备优势。

example.english: The flat has a lot going for it: sunlight, space and a great location.
example.chinese: 这套公寓有很多优点：阳光充足、空间宽敞，而且位置很好。
highlights: has a lot going for it

chinese: 凡是你想得到的（都有）；应有尽有
note: 强调种类齐全，并非单纯“你能想到”。

example.english: The market sells bread, flowers, books; you name it.
example.chinese: 这个市场卖面包、鲜花、书籍，凡是你想得到的都有。

chinese: 报名参加……

example.english: I decided to sign up for a weekend cooking class.
example.chinese: 我决定报名参加周末的烹饪课。

chinese: 某行业的诀窍；内行的门道
note: 补上原图漏写的 the。

example.english: The experienced baker taught me a few tricks of the trade.
example.chinese: 那位经验丰富的面包师教了我一些行内诀窍。

english: it is not unknown for sb. to do sth.
chinese: 某人做某事并非没有先例；这种事有时会发生
note: 修正 unknown 并补全 for sb. to do 结构。

example.english: It is not unknown for him to miss a deadline.
example.chinese: 他有时也会错过截止日期。

chinese: 从……得到启示；仿效……的做法
note: 结合中文将 cu… 推定为 cue；my 泛化为 one's，随主语变化。

example.english: I took my cue from the other guests and removed my shoes.
example.chinese: 我照着其他客人的做法，脱下了鞋子。

chinese: 有点；有几分（非正式）
note: 与名词短语 a kind of 区分。

example.english: I was kind of nervous before the interview.
example.chinese: 面试前我有点紧张。

chinese: 一种……
note: 原 kind of + n. 补全 a kind of；复数可用 kinds of。

example.english: A kayak is a kind of small boat.
example.chinese: 皮划艇是一种小型船只。

chinese: 鉴于……；考虑到……
note: 美式也常省略 the。

example.english: In light of the forecast, we moved the picnic indoors.
example.chinese: 考虑到天气预报，我们把野餐改到了室内。

chinese: 严格说来；就该事物本身而言；以这种身份
note: such 通常承接前文身份或类别，不能一概替换 therefore。

example.english: I don't have an office as such; I work at the kitchen table.
example.chinese: 我没有严格意义上的办公室；我在厨房的餐桌旁工作。

chinese: 为了做某事

example.english: We left early in order to avoid the traffic.
example.chinese: 为了避开拥堵，我们早早出发了。

chinese: 不必做某事；没有必要做某事
note: 情态动词 need 后接动词原形，不加 to；不是“禁止”。

example.english: You need not bring any tools; we provide everything.
example.chinese: 你不必带任何工具；我们会提供所需的一切。

chinese: 让／请别人做某事；遭遇某事
note: 原 have + 东西 + 过去分词；补充 have one's bag stolen 等遭遇义。

example.english: I'm going to have my bicycle repaired this weekend.
example.chinese: 这个周末我打算请人修理自行车。

chinese: 结果是……；原来是……

example.english: The missing key turned out to be in my coat pocket.
example.chinese: 那把找不到的钥匙原来在我的外套口袋里。

chinese: 区分 A 与 B；辨别 A 和 B 的不同

example.english: Can you distinguish the original from the copy?
example.chinese: 你能区分原件和复制品吗？

chinese: 在……中根深蒂固；牢固地存在于……中
note: 结合“根深蒂固”推定拼写为 entrenched。

example.english: These habits are entrenched in our daily routines.
example.chinese: 这些习惯在我们的日常生活中根深蒂固。

chinese: 此外；另外

example.english: The room is bright. In addition, it has a balcony.
example.chinese: 这个房间很明亮，此外还带有一个阳台。

chinese: A 和 B 两者都；既……又……

example.english: The course covers both speaking and writing.
example.chinese: 这门课程既涵盖口语，也涵盖写作。

chinese: 就……而言；从……方面来说

example.english: In terms of price, the two options are almost identical.
example.chinese: 就价格而言，这两种选择几乎没有区别。

chinese: 在……人群中普遍存在或流行
note: among 通常接人群。

example.english: Online shopping is prevalent among the people in our survey.
example.chinese: 网上购物在我们调查的人群中很普遍。

chinese: 着手处理问题；应对问题
note: 不保证问题已经解决，避免直接背成“解决了”。

example.english: We need to address the parking problem before it gets worse.
example.chinese: 我们需要在停车问题变得更严重之前着手处理它。

chinese: 无力做某事；不能做某事
note: 这是名词短语。

example.english: His inability to swim made him nervous near deep water.
example.chinese: 他不会游泳，因此靠近深水时会紧张。

chinese: 把 A 作为 B 的例子或榜样
note: 尤其是作为正面榜样。

example.english: The coach held up her teamwork as an example to us all.
example.chinese: 教练把她的团队合作精神作为我们所有人的榜样。

chinese: 转化为……；翻译成……
note: 保留原“转化成”，补充字面翻译义。

example.english: More practice can translate into greater confidence.
example.chinese: 更多的练习可以转化为更强的自信心。

chinese: 考虑到……；为……留出余地；使……成为可能
note: “使成为可能”须看语境；增加考虑、预留的核心常用义。

example.english: Allow for heavy traffic when planning your journey.
example.chinese: 规划行程时，要把交通拥堵考虑在内。

chinese: 能承受……的冲击；受……影响后能恢复
note: 比一般“能抵抗”更强调恢复能力或韧性。

example.english: These plants are resilient to sudden changes in temperature.
example.chinese: 这些植物能承受气温骤变的影响。

chinese: 利用某物；使用某物

example.english: We can make use of the empty room for meetings.
example.chinese: 我们可以利用这个空房间开会。

chinese: 在……发生的时候

example.english: I was asleep at the time of the phone call.
example.chinese: 电话打来时，我正在睡觉。

chinese: 只需要……；所需的不过是……
note: is 后根据语境接名词或动词不定式。

example.english: All it takes is a few minutes of practice each day.
example.chinese: 只需要每天练习几分钟就可以了。

chinese: 宣布／宣称 A 是 B
note: B 可为名词或形容词。

example.english: The judges declared her to be the winner.
example.chinese: 评委宣布她是获胜者。

chinese: 更有甚者；最后再加上一件事（可好可坏）
note: 并不只表示“更糟糕的是”。

example.english: I missed the bus and, to top it all off, it started raining.
example.chinese: 我错过了公交车，更糟的是，天又开始下雨了。

chinese: 开始着手做某事
note: 原图“着手做”义，不是去工作地点。

example.english: The volunteers went to work clearing the paths.
example.chinese: 志愿者们开始着手清理小路。

chinese: 一心想做某事；决意做某事
note: 补全 be；intent on 后用 -ing。

example.english: She is intent on finishing the course before summer.
example.chinese: 她决意在夏天之前完成这门课程。

chinese: 与……有关
note: 原结构可成立，也常见 have to do with。

example.english: The problem is to do with the software, not the screen.
example.chinese: 这个问题与软件有关，而不是屏幕的问题。

chinese: 导致……；造成……结果

example.english: A small mistake can result in hours of extra work.
example.chinese: 一个小错误可能导致额外花上好几个小时的工作。

chinese: ……在……中发挥的作用
note: 原 the role … has in … 可依语境理解；规范为常用搭配 play a role in。

example.english: The study examines the role sleep plays in learning.
example.chinese: 这项研究考察睡眠在学习中发挥的作用。

chinese: A 与 B 完全相同

example.english: My suitcase is identical to yours, so I added a red ribbon.
example.chinese: 我的行李箱和你的一模一样，所以我系了一条红丝带。

chinese: 作为对……的回应；响应……
note: 修正 response 拼写。

example.english: The café added more seats in response to customer requests.
example.chinese: 咖啡馆应顾客的要求增加了座位。

chinese: 范围从 A 到 B；介于 A 与 B 之间
note: 原 ranging 还原为原形 range。

example.english: The visitors' ages range from eighteen to eighty.
example.chinese: 参观者的年龄从十八岁到八十岁不等。

chinese: 指出 A 是 B；把 A 作为 B 的证据或例子提出
note: 按指出／证据义整理，不能简单等同于“认为”。

example.english: She pointed to the empty shelves as evidence of strong demand.
example.chinese: 她指出，空空的货架就是需求旺盛的证据。

chinese: 旨在做某事；被设计用来做某事
note: 原 be intend to do 修正为 be intended to do；区分 intend to do（打算做）。

example.english: This guide is intended to help new students settle in.
example.chinese: 这份指南旨在帮助新生适应新环境。

chinese: 在这样做时；通过这样做

example.english: He repaired the chair and, in doing so, learned a useful skill.
example.chinese: 他修好了椅子，并在这个过程中学会了一项实用技能。

chinese: 从 A 到 B（表示起止、变化或范围）
note: 结构本身不必然表示“范围很大”。

example.english: The shop is open from nine to six.
example.chinese: 这家店的营业时间是九点到六点。

english: take a turn at doing sth.
chinese: 轮到或轮流参与做某事一次
note: 保留 a turn；take turns doing sth. 强调多人轮流。

example.english: Everyone took a turn at stirring the soup.
example.chinese: 每个人都轮流搅拌了一次汤。

chinese: 相对于……；与……相比；关于……

example.english: The rent is low relative to other flats in this area.
example.chinese: 与这一带其他公寓相比，这里的租金较低。

chinese: 通过做某事；以做某事的方式
note: by 后接动词 -ing。

example.english: You can save time by preparing your bag the night before.
example.chinese: 你可以在前一天晚上收拾好包，以节省时间。

english: be true for / of sb. or sth.
chinese: 对某人或某事同样成立；同样适用
note: 常见搭配 the same is true of/for。

example.english: These rooms include breakfast; the same is true for the cheaper rooms.
example.chinese: 这些客房的房价包含早餐，较便宜的客房也同样如此。

chinese: 使得……；其情况或程度达到……（引出结果或条件）
note: 不等同于表目的的 in order that；区别 such + 名词 + that。

example.english: The chairs were arranged such that everyone could see the screen.
example.chinese: 椅子被摆放得让每个人都能看见屏幕。

chinese: 在任何时刻；在任何阶段或位置

example.english: You can pause the lesson at any point and come back later.
example.chinese: 你可以在任何时候暂停课程，稍后再继续。

chinese: 最终做了某事；到头来做了某事
note: 常暗示并非原先计划的结果。

example.english: We meant to cook, but we ended up ordering pizza.
example.chinese: 我们原本打算做饭，最后却点了披萨。

english: twice as many + plural noun + as …
chinese: ……的数量是……的两倍（接可数名词复数）
note: 数量两倍；不是增加两倍。

example.english: We sold twice as many tickets as we expected.
example.chinese: 我们售出的票数是预期的两倍。

chinese: 使某人确信某事；让某人相信……
note: 结合中文，将首词规范为 convince；of 后接名词性内容。

example.english: Her explanation convinced me of the need for change.
example.chinese: 她的解释让我确信，有必要作出改变。

chinese: 评论文章；书评、影评等（review 的复数）
note: 按笔记保留名词复数；这里不是动词“复习”的意思。

example.english: I read several reviews before choosing a book.
example.chinese: 选书之前，我读了几篇书评。

chinese: 在报刊上；在新闻媒体的报道中
note: 将手写 pres 规范为 press；不是单独的“新闻”。

example.english: The new exhibition received a lot of attention in the press.
example.chinese: 这场新展览受到了新闻媒体的广泛关注。

chinese: 有人呼吁／要求……
note: 原文 There were calls for 为过去时；卡片整理为可复用的现在时句型，讲过去的事仍用 were。

example.english: There are calls for a safer crossing outside the school.
example.chinese: 有人呼吁在学校外设置一处更安全的人行横道。

chinese: 与某事物几乎不相像；几乎没有相似之处
note: 规范 resemblance 拼写；little 是“几乎没有”，不是完全没有。

example.english: The finished building bears little resemblance to the original drawing.
example.chinese: 完工后的建筑与最初的图纸几乎不像。

chinese: 把 A 变成 B
note: 保留原笔记结构；A、B 表示可替换的人或事物。

example.english: We turned the unused garage into a small studio.
example.chinese: 我们把闲置的车库改成了一间小工作室。

chinese: 把某事的发生或成就归因于／归功于某人或某事
note: 对应笔记的因果义，不能笼统翻成“受……影响”；owe 另外还有“欠”的含义，要看宾语与语境。

example.english: I owe my confidence to my patient teacher.
example.chinese: 我的自信要归功于那位耐心的老师。

chinese: 把 A 逐步发展或改造成 B
note: 将原 developed 规范为原形；原句若为过去时仍需 developed。

example.english: She developed a simple idea into a successful business.
example.chinese: 她把一个简单的想法逐步发展成了一家成功的企业。

chinese: 需要大量 X 投入的；X 密集型的（如 labour-intensive：劳动密集型的）
note: 构词模式；X 应为适合搭配的资源或投入，如 labour、capital、energy，并非任意名词都自然。

example.english: Making these baskets by hand is labour-intensive.
example.chinese: 手工制作这些篮子需要投入大量劳动力。

chinese: 一次性付清某物的全部价款
note: 补全常用结构；限定在付款语境，outright 还有完全、立即等其他义项。

example.english: I saved until I could pay for the bike outright.
example.chinese: 我一直攒钱，直到能一次性付清那辆自行车的全款。

chinese: 分期支付某物的价款（美式拼写：installments）
note: 原笔记写 pay over＝分期付款。该片段不足以表达此义，可能省略了 time 或时间段；未据此断定原句。按中文意图改用明确的词典搭配。

example.english: She chose to pay for the laptop in instalments.
example.chinese: 她选择分期支付那台笔记本电脑的价款。
